deepdive.thesis: One Global Service Provider Limited turned a loss into a profit of ₹233.28L in FY21 by strategically investing in plant and equipment while sourcing heavily from MSMEs, positioning itself as a beneficiary of India's PLI-driven manufacturing revival. The company's reduced retained loss and increased trade receivables/payables signal operational scaling and supply chain integration.
